project_context.name: TyA Consultores Platform
project_context.type: Hybrid B2B SaaS (Desktop Dashboard + Mobile Audit Field App)
project_context.theme: Light theme default for high data visibility, dark mode optional.

headings.usage: High-impact page titles, module headers, marketing elements.

body.usage: Data tables, form inputs, audit checklists, long-form text.

mono.usage: Audit IDs, timestamps, numeric KPIs, coordinates.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton, make the grid visible.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders everywhere. border-slate-200 for containers.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Zero soft shadows. Rely on 1px borders and slight background color shifts (slate-50 to white). For floating elements (menus, modals), use a very crisp shadow: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)].
visual_enhancers.radius: Minimal. Use rounded-sm (2px) or rounded-md (4px) max. Avoid pill shapes unless it's a specific status badge.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data-heavy views. Use solid white backgrounds to prevent visual refraction of data.

components_and_patterns.cards: Cardless look or strict rectangles. border border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-md p-4 to p-6.
components_and_patterns.data_tables: Dense list patterns. Progressive disclosure. Compact data tables with sticky headers, sortable columns, right-aligned numbers for metrics, zebra striping optional but clear row hover states (hover:bg-slate-50) are mandatory.
components_and_patterns.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn UI standard. Rectangular, subtle borders. Clear focus rings (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2). Labels must be bold or semi-bold. Input padding optimized for touch on mobile.
components_and_patterns.buttons: Flat, sharp edges or small radius. Primary buttons use brand blue. Secondary buttons are transparent with 1px border. Explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-blue-800 hover:text-white).
components_and_patterns.chatbot: Floating bottom-right. Sharp rectangular container, not a playful bubble. Serious tone.
components_and_patterns.dashboard_kpis: Top-level stat cards followed by detailed tables. Use an F-pattern layout.
components_and_patterns.mobile_execution: Bento grid for touch targets. Bottom navigation bar. Large camera/audio upload buttons. Offline-first visual indicators.

grids_and_layouts.desktop: Sidebar navigation (left, 240px or 64px collapsed). Top header with breadcrumbs and user profile. Main content uses grid-cols-12 with gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.mobile: Mobile-first for the field auditor app. Stacked grid-cols-1 with gap-4. Touch targets minimum 48x48px.
grids_and_layouts.padding: Generous internal padding for containers (p-6 or p-8) to avoid text collision with borders.

motion.strategy: Functional and snappy. No bouncy or slow animations.
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out for hovers. transition-transform duration-200 for drawer/sidebar sliding.
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders (animate-pulse on gray rectangles) instead of spinners for data tables to maintain layout stability.
motion.avoid: Parallax, heavy 3D, or decorative motion. This is an operational tool.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA or APCA compliance. Grey text must be at least text-slate-500 on white.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring.
accessibility.testing_tags: All buttons, inputs, and links MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility.aria: Use aria-expanded, aria-controls for dropdowns and sidebars. aria-live for AI chatbot responses and OCR processing status.

media_and_icons.icons: Phosphor Icons (via @phosphor-icons/react). Use 'regular' weight for UI, 'fill' for active states. Serious, technical geometry.
media_and_icons.images_strategy: Use realistic corporate and field worker images for placeholders, empty states, or landing mockups. No illustrations.

image_urls.description: Professional corporate office for login background

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all Shadcn components are styled with sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm) to match the Swiss aesthetic.
Do not use generic 'blue-to-purple' gradients. This is a serious B2B consulting app.
Use data-dense table layouts for Campaign and Form modules. Ensure progressive disclosure.
The mobile view (for field auditors) must prioritize large buttons and clear checklist UI.
Implement a persistent, non-intrusive floating chatbot with a technical, chat-window style (not a playful bubble).
Use IBM Plex Sans for body text and Cabinet Grotesk for headings. Install via Google Fonts or Fontsource.
Never apply universal 'transition: all' in CSS. Target specific properties.
Include data-testid on every clickable element.
Create a solid header with a white or slate-50 background. No transparent headers over content.
Ensure Javascript (.js/.jsx) is used as requested, not TSX. Avoid TypeScript syntax.
Create comprehensive layouts and dashboards integrating KPIs, forms, lists and modals matching the data-dense list patterns.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create distinctive, serious B2B frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements and 1px borders, rather than soft shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Left-align text for readability.
Use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Use Sonner for toasts.
